newsitem.title: USA: Security-Connecticut rating cut by A.M. Best.
newsitem.headline: Security-Connecticut rating cut by A.M. Best.

text.p: Security-Connecticut Corp said A.M. Best is cutting the rating on Security Connecticut Life Insurance Co and its unit to "A (Excellent)" from "A+ (Excellent)".
Security-Connecticut said it disagrees and is disappointed with the rating agency's decision, especially after reporting third quarter results today.
Earlier, it reported an $8.4 million or $0.97 per share profit for the third quarter, compared to $7.8 million or $0.90 last year.
"We are disappointed with A.M. Best's decision and we disagree with its conclusion," said chairman Ronald Jarvis.

"Consider the irony of our two announcements today. We are reporting record third quarter results on the very same day A.M. Best reclassifies our rating. The facts show that we are a much stronger company today than when Best first rated us A+ in 1989," Jarvis said.
